bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/ (built-in instruments and effects), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (audio service)
summary: Apple's Audio Unit framework hosts third-party AU v2 and v3 plug-ins and provides the AUAudioUnit subclassing API for plug-in extensions. BifrOSt has no plug-in host and no plug-in extension API. The DAW ships its own built-in instruments and effects as JavaScript plug-in directories, which are not Audio Units. The Apple page itself marks the framework as deprecated in favour of Audio Toolbox.

features.feature: Hosting third-party AU v2 and v3 plug-ins
features.apple: AUAudioUnit, AudioUnit instantiation (Audio Unit framework landing page)
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-31, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no code loads an external plug-in binary; grep for audio unit, AUv2/AUv3, clap, lv2, vst, dlopen of plug-ins returned only system library loads (springboard/src/media/dl.rs, springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs)

features.apple: AUAudioUnit subclassing for app extensions (landing page: Version 3 extensions)
features.note: no extension point for apps to ship audio processors

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/fx.rs (17 effects), springboard/apps/daw/src/dsp.rs (biquad, compressor, delay, LFO, oscillator)
features.note: DAW-only, not exposed to other apps as an audio unit; effect routing is fixed in the DAW
instrument set is fixed; sample-based instruments load from plugin.json and zones.json folders
parameters are defined per built-in device; no parameter tree or preset API for external processors

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/playback.rs (Player renders to a cache), springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs (convolver)
features.note: rendering is internal to the DAW and is not an app-facing render API

features.apple: Audio Unit host and Core Audio I/O (not a separate Apple feature row)
features.bifrost: springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (audio service owns speaker and microphone), springboard/src/media/alsalib.rs (ALSA output)
features.note: the service exists, but the SDK has no audio module (springboard/sdk/src/ has no audio file)

features.apple: MIDI events delivered to instrument units
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-audio-unit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. note data is internal to the DAW; no MIDI device input or MIDI event API found Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: No plug-in host for AU v2 or v3, and no way to load third-party audio processors into the DAW or any app.
No AUAudioUnit-style extension point for apps to ship audio processors.
No app-facing audio unit or render API; the DAW's rendering and devices are internal.
No MIDI input or MIDI event API.
The audio service (springboard/audiod) has no SDK module for apps.
